items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Field and escape (catalog_gap + nearest FR), presence-only F11 check, docs, tests and replay delivered; replay counts only events that list changed_files.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Missing event, other intent, no runtime path and blind git view all SKIP; a crashing check is caught by the registry.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Read-only over local event logs; no input reaches a shell or path.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 20 tests cover path classes, presence-only stance, pass/fail/skip/blind and the replay counts.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One linear read of the events log.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Rule in lib, check in its own verifier registered in CLAIM_CHECKS; iterate_checks.py untouched.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer is the F5b extras JSON (merged freely), consumer is the F11 check; probed with a real events.jsonl in tests.
